outcome: Maternal and cord plasma anti-spike protein antibody levels
Neutralizing potency against Wuhan and Omicron strains
Transplacental transfer ratio of SARS-CoV-2 antibodies
cohort: 75 maternal-infant dyads, 38 from mothers infected with COVID-19 and 37 from uninfected mothers
finding: Pregnant women vaccinated in the third trimester had the highest antibody levels and neutralizing potency against SARS-CoV-2, and COVID-19 infection negatively impacted antibody transfer to infants.
